support_density.receptive_field_conclusion: A_final is the support every STBlock diffuses over. It is structurally dense (100% of entries positive) and effectively dense (each row spreads over 107 of 207 nodes, 52% of uniform), so the model's spatial receptive field is the FULL GRAPH IN ONE HOP. gcn_order x n_blocks bounds diffusion over the PHYSICAL component only. Any stratum defined by hop distance in the kernel adjacency is therefore a geometric description, not an architectural limit, and influence falling outside it is not surprising.
